image_prompt: Martin Luther as a cyberpunk anime character: A stern-faced man in his mid-50s with sharp, angular features and penetrating dark eyes that convey both intellectual intensity and spiritual conviction. His face bears the weathered lines of scholarly rigor and moral struggle. He has thick, dark hair streaked with grey, swept back from his forehead. His build is robust and commanding, shoulders broad and posture rigid with Prussian formality. He wears a high-collared black clerical coat with cybernetic theological insignia glowing faintly along the shoulders and chest—intricate geometric patterns in pale blue light representing Lutheranism merged with advanced technology. Underneath, visible at the collar, is a simple white shirt with subtle circuitry embroidery. His hands are large and expressive, with faint bioluminescent Lutheran crosses tattooed on his knuckles. His expression is austere, resolute, and quietly defiant—the face of a spiritual idol tempered by dark irony and intellectual awakening. The overall effect merges Renaissance religious authority with futuristic, high-tech aesthetics.
book_context: Catherine the Great: A Life (or similar biographical work on Catherine II)
